answer: Insurance-pool mutual bonding resists sybils: identities post into a shared insurance pool and a detected bad actor's claim is paid from the collective, so honest members have direct incentive to police and expel sybils whose losses would drain them. A nebula of fakes raises everyone's premiums, giving the honest majority reason to vote them out; the cipher of each member's stake is at risk from others. One honest agent contributes to the karst-deep pool and benefits from its stability; a farm free-riding on fakes is economically ejected by the members it endangers.
